title: Verify concurrent analog Tesla and optical audio mixing
problem: The exact installed HELIX DSP and active configuration are unconfirmed. Product specifications and PC-Tool routing documentation do not prove uninterrupted simultaneous analog Tesla and optical input mixing in this installation.
desiredOutcome: Evidence-backed go/no-go decision for simultaneous input mixing and isolated digital mute before purchasing Pi S/PDIF hardware.
dependencies: Confirm exact HELIX model/revision/firmware; obtain qualified installer and backed-up test configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Analog Tesla audio and optical PCM are heard simultaneously without source switching
HELIX digital volume/mute affects only digital contribution
Tesla warning/alert audio remains unaffected
Test configuration and baseline restore evidence archived
physicalTests: Bench or authorized installer test with simultaneous sources and actual DSP
risks: A failed mixing or mute test blocks purchase and integration design.

title: Test Commander telemetry streaming with S3XY Dash active
problem: Enhance Auto documents Panda Wi-Fi/UDP telemetry access and warns additional clients can interrupt Dash data. Reliable concurrent embedded telemetry and Dash operation is unknown.
desiredOutcome: Prove or reject the Commander path without degrading installed Dash behavior.
dependencies: Identify Commander generation and firmware; define passive test method.
acceptanceCriteria: Dash remains fully functional through agreed wake/reconnect test cases
Receive timestamps, packet intervals, loss and reconnect behavior recorded
No CAN transmit path used
physicalTests: Receive-only capture with Dash monitored; stop if Dash degrades
risks: If coexistence fails, use independent read-only telemetry research instead.

title: Verify Highland-compatible passive telemetry and signals
problem: Accelerator position, speed, torque and regen signal IDs/frequencies/semantics have not been validated for the exact Highland build.
desiredOutcome: Approved source and signal matrix with freshness, units, ranges, invalid values and compatibility evidence.
dependencies: Verify applicable market/build service information; qualified review before physical interface selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Every required signal has documented source, units, update behavior and validation method
Older Model 3 mappings are not presumed applicable
No command or injection support exists in design
physicalTests: Read-only interface and stationary controlled signal validation if separately authorized
risks: Vehicle configuration differs by production market and hardware; Tesla disclaims third-party wiring support.

title: Bench-verify Raspberry Pi and optical S/PDIF interface
problem: Pi model/revision and Digi2 Pro revision compatibility are not confirmed; HiFiBerry documents a Pi 4 Rev 1.5 caveat.
desiredOutcome: Stable ALSA 48 kHz stereo PCM over TOSLINK to the actual HELIX input.
dependencies: Identify Pi PCB revision; HELIX mixing gate must pass before procurement.
acceptanceCriteria: Exact board/interface revisions recorded
48 kHz stereo output stable with no underruns over defined run
Optical lock verified at HELIX
physicalTests: Bench-only audio stream and sustained underrun/thermal test
risks: Do not order interface before DSP mixing gate passes.

title: Develop Highland-safe Pi power and shutdown design
problem: No vehicle-specific low-voltage voltage range, wake/sleep behavior, tap, fuse, current, transient protection or converter design is verified.
desiredOutcome: Qualified installer reviewed power architecture and controlled shutdown/parked draw acceptance criteria.
dependencies: Applicable service information and qualified installer assessment.
acceptanceCriteria: Wake/sleep and parked draw demonstrated
Protection/fuse/current values traced to measurements and qualified design
Power-loss and filesystem recovery tests pass
physicalTests: Electrical measurements and wake/sleep test by qualified person
risks: Generic 12 V assumptions may cause damage or battery drain; no wiring modifications authorized.

title: Complete speaker inventory and DSP commissioning record
problem: Passenger-side woofer installation, separate tweeter channels, final routing and acoustic calibration remain incomplete.
desiredOutcome: Traceable installer-approved speaker mapping, protected crossover configuration, measured calibration and restorable DSP backup.
dependencies: Separate authorization for physical work and live DSP changes; exact HELIX model/firmware.
acceptanceCriteria: All actual channels and speakers mapped
Values measured, not guessed
Warnings preserved
Before/after presets and measurements archived
physicalTests: Speaker polarity, phase, response, time alignment and balance measurements
risks: Protect tweeters and preserve safety audio; do not infer installation-specific settings.
